# Built by Josh Studio

> Built by Josh Studio LLC is a one-person creative studio in Kansas. It publishes Notion OS templates and Excel/Google Sheets workbooks under its Tynkr Tools & Co brand, zodiac digital art under its own name, fiction as J.S. Warden, the Nước Mắm cookbook as Josh Tran, guided print planners, and a suite of free browser tools — all built by a single founder.

Built by Josh Studio LLC (a Kansas limited liability company formed in 2026; the studio started in 2025 as a one-person practice) is the company behind everything on builtbyjoshstudio.com and its subdomains. Tynkr Tools & Co is its productivity brand: Notion templates are the creator line, Excel/Google Sheets workbooks are the consumer line, plus guided print planners, free web tools, and upcoming local-first Windows desktop apps. The zodiac art collections are published directly under the studio's own name. Under the pen name J.S. Warden, Josh writes fiction — *Overlayed Echoes* (a near-future LitRPG, Book 1 of a planned five-book series) and *Ebonspire Chronicles* (a dark fantasy detective noir; Book One is out). As Josh Tran he wrote *Nước Mắm — A Vietnamese Family Cookbook* and co-hosts the Josh & Jordan's Kitchen cooking channel on YouTube. Little Acre Learning (children's books and printables, littleacrelearning.com) is a separate brand of the same LLC.

How things are sold: templates, workbooks, the cookbook, and art are instant downloads with checkout by Lemon Squeezy on this domain (the cookbook on cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com). The Tynkr desktop apps are coming soon to the Microsoft Store. The Tynkr templates, workbooks, and the cookbook are also listed on Etsy (shop: tynkrtoolsandco) as a secondary option; books and planners are on Amazon. The zodiac bundles, as packaged on this site, are sold here — the Built by Josh Studio Etsy shop (etsy.com/shop/BuiltByJoshStudio) carries individual prints and other studio work. All sales of digital goods bought on this site are final (technical issues are always fixed). Tynkr desktop apps are purchased through the Microsoft Store, and refunds for them are handled by Microsoft under its terms. Every paid Tynkr template and workbook has a free Lite version. A fuller, machine-readable fact file lives at https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms-full.txt.

## About, books, cookbook

- [About the studio and Josh](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/about.html): Canonical About page: the founder's background, how the studio is organized (Built by Josh Studio LLC as the company, Tynkr Tools & Co as its productivity brand, zodiac art under the studio's own name, fiction as J.S. Warden, the cookbook as Josh Tran, Little Acre Learning for kids), both YouTube channels, and how to reach the studio.
- [Books — J.S. Warden fiction](https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/books/): Fiction under the pen name J.S. Warden — Overlayed Echoes (near-future LitRPG, Book 1 of a planned five-book series; Kindle $5.99, paperback $12.99, hardcover $23.99, free on Kindle Unlimited; Amazon B0H3826V21) and Ebonspire Chronicles (dark fantasy detective noir, Book One; Kindle $7.99 at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H8BRT4NF, free on Kindle Unlimited, paperback $14.99, hardcover $25.99; a completely separate world from Overlayed Echoes). Writing site index: https://writing.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt.
- [Nước Mắm — A Vietnamese Family Cookbook](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/cookbook/): A 56-page Vietnamese family cookbook by Josh Tran (his own name, not the pen name) — fish sauce and core sauces, summer rolls, bún bowls, over-rice dishes, fried spring rolls, bánh mì, and a twelve-hour phở, balanced by tasting rather than measuring. $3.99 ebook (EPUB + PDF, instant download); also on Kindle at $3.99 (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBCXTLWD) and on Etsy at $3.99 (https://www.etsy.com/listing/4551851115/nc-mm-vietnamese-family-cookbook-o). Paperback: $7.99 on Amazon (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HBL7HZYN; 80 pages, 5 x 8 in, ISBN 979-8188988173, published July 25, 2026). Companion cooking channel: Josh & Jordan's Kitchen on YouTube (https://www.youtube.com/@joshandjordanskitchen).
- [Cooking — the Josh & Jordan's Kitchen hub](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/): The cooking section landing page: cook-along videos (short version plus the full real-time cook), the Nước Mắm cookbook, fifteen kitchen essays and tool write-ups, and free kitchen calculators. The kitchen cooks by taste rather than by measurement. Cooking site index: https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt.
- [Kitchen Videos — Josh & Jordan's Kitchen cooks](https://cooking.builtbyjoshstudio.com/videos/): Every cook from the Josh & Jordan's Kitchen YouTube channel in two versions: a short version embedded on the page, and a link to the full real-time cook with nothing sped up. Currently: Sugar Cookie Cups (same method as the chocolate chip cups, a well pressed into each cup while hot: 4-minute version, 10-minute full bake), Rotisserie Chicken Stock (from the breakdown's carcass, vegetables sweated before any liquid, 13 hours on low: 11-minute cut, 35-minute uncut cook), Chocolate Chip Cookie Cups (bite-sized, made from the cookie dough in a mini muffin pan: 6-minute version, 11-minute real-time bake), How to Break Down a Rotisserie Chicken With No Waste (5-minute version, 10-minute real-time breakdown; the first of five meals from one chicken), Chocolate Chip Cookie Dough (Jordan's first bake: under-3-minute version, 9-minute complete bake), Steak & Pepper Rice Bowls (15-minute cut, 27-minute real-time cook), Ground Beef Taco Bowls (15-minute cut, 28-minute real-time cook), How to Condition a Wood Cutting Board (2-minute everyday board care) and How to Oil an End Grain Cutting Board (5-minute deep-drink revival), Chunky Guacamole (3-minute sped-up version, 10-minute real-time cook), One-Skillet Spicy Sausage Hash (15-minute cut, 82-minute uncut) and Ground Beef Bulgogi Bowls (15-minute cut, 44-minute uncut). No measurements — the cooking is done by taste. Videos load only when clicked.
- [Built by Josh Studio — home](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/): The studio's front door: Tynkr Tools & Co templates and workbooks, free Lite versions, the zodiac art collections, and planners.

- [How to Launch a Digital Product Without an Audience](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/how-to-launch-digital-product-without-audience.html): No email list, no following, no launch? Here's how to sell your first digital product from zero — a realistic playbook for audience-less launches.
- [The 50/30/20 Rule Is Outdated — Here's What Actually Works in 2026](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/50-30-20-rule-outdated-budgeting-2026.html): The 50/30/20 budget worked when rent didn't eat half your income. Here's why the rule breaks in 2026 — and what to budget with instead.
- [How Much House Can You Actually Afford? (The Honest Math)](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/how-much-house-can-you-actually-afford.html): Lenders calculate affordability one way. Real life calculates it another. Here's the honest math behind home affordability — including the costs lenders don't include.
- [Sinking Funds Explained: How to Budget for Expenses That Aren't Monthly](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/sinking-funds-explained.html): A sinking fund is how you stop letting predictable expenses wreck your budget. What they are, how to set them up, and the categories most people miss.
- [Zero-Based Budget Excel Template + How to Build One (2026)](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/zero-based-budget-excel.html): Build a zero-based budget in Excel step by step — every dollar gets a job. Grab the free starter template, the formulas, and a full setup walkthrough.
- [First-Time Homebuyer Mistakes: The Mortgage Math Most Buyers Skip](https://builtbyjoshstudio.com/blog/first-time-homebuyer-mistakes.html): The expensive mistakes first-time homebuyers make because they skip the real math — affordability, true monthly cost, closing costs, and rent vs. buy. No fluff.

## Desktop apps — Tynkr Tools & Co (coming soon)

Four privacy-first, local-first Windows desktop apps. User data lives in flat files on the user's machine — no cloud, no accounts, no subscriptions. Site: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ (its own index: https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/llms.txt)

- [Tynkr Ledger — Personal Finance OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/ledger/): Transactions, budgets, bills, debt payoff, and net worth on your own disk.
- [Tynkr Vault — Second Brain OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/vault/): Notes, tasks, and weekly reviews as plain Markdown files you own, with fast fuzzy search.
- [Tynkr Hearth — Homebuyer OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/hearth/): The whole home purchase, mapped — mortgage math, down payment planning, cash-to-close, roadmap, document tracker.
- [Tynkr Forge — Small Business OS](https://tynkr.builtbyjoshstudio.com/forge/): Invoicing, CRM, purchase orders, contracts, expenses with receipts, and proposals in one app.
